svg.aria-label: NB-IoT channel estimation from NRS and equalisation
svg.title: NB-IoT channel estimation from NRS and equalisation
svg.text: Correcting the radio path: reference signals in, clean QPSK out
One subframe of cell 260 (14 symbols × 12 subcarriers)
8 red squares per subframe = NRS pilots.
I know their exact values (a Gold sequence
seeded by PCI 260 and the slot number), so
what I receive there, divided by what was sent,
is the radio path H itself.
What my decoder does with them, once per 10 ms frame
8 per subframe, up to 72 per frame
leftover CFO: phase drift per symbol
Sketch: the "after" spread matches the measured 13 dB QPSK SNR; the "before" ring is illustrative.
